argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Moderate; premises often embedded in rhetorical questions and genealogical diagnoses

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High; anticipates and addresses self-refutation, circularity, and relativism objections
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: Strong; all sections contribute to resolving the central tension
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Contestable; relies on Nietzschean vitalism and anti-foundationalist commitments

distinctions_drawn: Dogmatic closure vs. Openness to experience
explicit_definitions_given: Sensation is pre-linguistic and pre-conceptual; it simply occurs
Interpretation is a conceptual translation that can hypostatize sensory data into static truths
Objectivity is the orchestration of multiple perspectives, not the elimination of perspective

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Systematic; each objection is answered by refining the normative standard
objections_raised: Self-refutation: If all claims are interpretations, then the claim itself is an interpretation
Explanatory circularity: Vital efficacy itself appears to smuggle in a normative standard
Relativism: Without absolute truth, any interpretation seems as good as any other
Matthews's charge: Nietzsche treats Presocratics as dramatic personalities, not philosophers

appeals_to_authority: Nietzsche's primary texts (PTAG, TI, GM, GS, BGE)
Maudemarie Clark and Wolfgang Müller-Lauter as supporting secondary literature
method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Textual exegesis, genealogical diagnosis, conceptual reconstruction, counterargument

philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: Overcoming metaphysics, epistemology of perspectivism, normative criteria for interpretation, historiography of philosophy

structural_organization.structure_type: Problem-solution with recursive deepening and final refutation of a named critic

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay resolves Nietzsche's apparent tension by shifting the evaluative standard from correspondence to vital efficacy and openness, and by distinguishing sensation (pre-linguistic, non-claiming) from interpretation (conceptual, potentially dogmatic). It then applies this standard to refute Matthews's charge that Nietzsche's Presocratics are merely aesthetic projections.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low; final conclusion is assertive but not dogmatic
